survey: An open cream envelope seen almost straight on, turned slightly in the picture plane. Its open top flap stands up behind the contents. Three or four photo prints fan out of the opening. The front print, showing a coastal village, is flat and parallel to the envelope's front, tipped a little to the left. The prints behind it fan back at small angles, and the envelope's front pocket edge cuts across all of them. The lower front shows the folded side and bottom flaps, which meet in a shallow V at the center. A postage stamp with a house icon sits at the upper right of the front. A round postmark with wavy cancel lines is printed on the lower front. The envelope floats with no ground plane. The village picture is a flat image inside the print and has its own consistent viewpoint, looking slightly down at the shore.
